BiblicalUsage: Ezekiel uses the word twice, both times of Pharaoh fouling the waters: he troubles the rivers with his feet and roils what was clear. God answers that the beasts will be destroyed from the great waters, and no foot of man or beast will trouble them any more.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture warns the powerful: those who muddy the water for everyone else will answer to the God who made it clear.
